name: week
title: Production: this week
subtitle: What needs a person, OEE by machine and the open actions

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select item, what, why, due from attention order by due, item

sections.title: OEE by machine, last 7 days
sections.sql: select machine, name, runs, round(availability * 100, 1) as availability_pct, round(performance * 100, 1) as performance_pct, round(quality * 100, 1) as quality_pct, round(oee * 100, 1) as oee_pct, round(target_oee * 100) as target_pct from machine_oee_7d order by oee nulls last
sections.note: OEE is good units at ideal speed over planned production time. Planned stops (breaks, planned maintenance, no orders) are not counted against it.

sections.title: Open improvement actions
sections.sql: select a.code, a.title, m.code as machine, a.owner, a.due_on from actions a left join machines m on m.id = a.machine_id where a.status = 'open' order by a.due_on nulls last

name: losses
title: Production losses
subtitle: Where the time and the product go: stops, changeovers, speed and rejects, last 28 days

sections.title: Downtime by reason
sections.sql: select reason, reason_name, loss, stops, minutes, pct, cumulative_pct from stop_pareto
sections.note: Fix the reasons at the top first: together they are most of the lost time.

sections.title: Changeovers by product pair
sections.sql: select machine, from_product, to_product, count(*)::int as times, round(avg(minutes), 1) as avg_min, min(minutes) as best_min from changeovers where run_date > current_date - 28 group by machine, from_product, to_product order by avg_min desc

sections.title: Rejects by reason
sections.sql: select o.machine, sr.name as reason, sum(x.qty)::int as units, o.currency, sum(x.qty * o.unit_cost_cents)::bigint as cost_cents from scrap x join scrap_reasons sr on sr.id = x.reason_id join run_oee o on o.id = x.run_id where o.run_date > current_date - 28 group by o.machine, sr.name, o.currency order by cost_cents desc

name: checks
title: Production checks
subtitle: Pre-start, CCP and weekly checks: what was done, what failed and what is due

sections.title: Every check, by machine
sections.sql: select machine, check_code, check_name, frequency, last_done, last_result, next_due from check_status order by machine, check_code

sections.title: Failed in the last 28 days
sections.sql: select cr.done_on, m.code as machine, ct.code as check_code, cr.done_by, cr.corrective_action from check_records cr join machines m on m.id = cr.machine_id join check_types ct on ct.id = cr.check_type_id where cr.result = 'fail' and cr.done_on > current_date - 28 order by cr.done_on desc
sections.note: A failed check with no corrective action written is a finding at audit. Write what was done with /checks.
